Each of the SLB Tractor Supply—Hudson, MI Mortgaged Property and the Wild Fork Foods—Aurora, IL Mortgaged Property is part of a shared tax parcel which also includes non-collateral property. The Mortgage Loan documents require the Mortgagor to cause each such Mortgaged Property to be separated from the non-collateral property so that it constitutes a separate tax lot (a “Reparcelization Event”), to occur with respect to each such Mortgaged Property as a normal, non-discretionary and ministerial administrative function of the applicable taxing jurisdiction, which such Reparcelization Event is required to be undertaken immediately after the origination date. Tax reserves for such Mortgaged Properties have been waived, and accordingly the Mortgagor is not reserving for such shared tax parcels.
